\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-49},
  title = {Predictions are not bias-corrected after the log transform},
  date = {2026-09-30},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Modelling Approach, Evaluation Protocol},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{predict\_\allowbreak{}eur} is \texttt{exp} of the model's log-space prediction, without Duan's smearing factor and without a lognormal variance correction.
The model estimates the conditional median price, which is what every metric we report measures.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Duan's smearing estimator: targets the conditional mean, so it shifts every prediction upward; measured on the test set, it made each variant slightly worse.
\item Lognormal variance correction: the same, with a distributional assumption on top.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Squared error on \texttt{log(price)} estimates the mean of the log, and \texttt{exp} of that is the median of the price.
MdAPE, the share within \ensuremath{\pm}20\,\% and the conformal intervals are all about the median or about quantiles.
A correction would also add a fitted constant that has to travel with the model and be applied identically in training, evaluation and the API.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI raised the question unprompted and argued from the target of the estimate, which decides it.
Its first write-up quoted effect sizes from a different run as if they were ours.
Re-measured on our data, the effect is an order of magnitude smaller, in the same direction.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-30 on issue \#37.},
  evidence = {\texttt{Model.\allowbreak{}predict\_\allowbreak{}eur} in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/modeling/model.py}{\texttt{model.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/model-card.md}{model card}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/37}{issue \#37}.},
}
